title: Microsoft Teams: explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants in GCC High and DoD
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and the cited Microsoft documentation. Its controls, dial-pad instructions and qualified consent-reporting claims are supported, and it explicitly reports the documentation differences and uncertainty about sovereign-cloud rollout behaviour.

claims.claim: The roadmap extends explicit recording and transcription consent to PSTN participants in Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments.

claims.claim: The roadmap says the feature is already available in Public and GCC.
claims.quote: This feature is already available in Public and GCC clouds and is now being extended to sovereign environments.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap says PSTN participants in recorded or transcribed meetings are prompted for explicit consent before unmuting and participating.
claims.quote: After this rollout, when a meeting is being recorded or transcribed, PSTN participants will be prompted to provide explicit consent before they can unmute and participate.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The roadmap says participants who do not provide consent remain muted for the duration of the meeting.
claims.quote: If consent is not provided, participants will remain muted for the duration of the meeting.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Audio Conferencing callers press 1 to consent to recording and transcription and unmute.
claims.quote: 1 - Give consent to being recorded and transcribed in a call and un-mute their microphone.

claims.claim: Audio Conferencing callers press 2 to decline and remain muted.
claims.quote: 2 – Deny recording and transcription, and remain muted.

claims.claim: A caller who previously declined can press *6 to unmute later.
claims.quote: If the user previously declined consent but later wants to unmute and speak, they can press *6 to unmute.

claims.claim: A caller attempting to speak after previously declining is prompted for consent again.
claims.quote: They are prompted to provide consent before they can speak.

claims.claim: Learn lists Audio Conferencing dial-in participants and PSTN endpoints in meetings and group calls as supported for explicit consent.
claims.quote: Explicit consent is supported on the following endpoints: ... Meeting participants dialing in using Audio Conferencing ... PSTN endpoints in meetings and group calls

claims.claim: Learn documents Require participant agreement for recording and transcription as Off (Disabled) by default.
claims.quote: | Off | Disabled | This setting is the default value. For organizers with this policy, participants aren't asked for consent to be recorded and transcribed.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: With the consent policy Off, participants are not asked and are included in recordings and transcripts.
claims.quote: For organizers with this policy, participants aren't asked for consent to be recorded and transcribed. All participants are included in recordings and transcripts from these organizers' meetings.

claims.claim: The documented consent control is admin-opt-in: it starts enforcing consent when an administrator enables it.
claims.quote: | On | Enabled | For organizers with this policy, all their meetings require participants to provide consent to be recorded and transcribed. | Off | Disabled | This setting is the default value.

claims.claim: The participant agreement page documents Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & Transcription > Require participant agreement for recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Under Meetings, select Meeting Policies. ... Within your chosen policy, navigate to the Recording & Transcription section. Toggle the Require participant agreement for recording and transcription setting On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled requires consent for meetings organised under that policy, including Audio Conferencing.
claims.quote: The -ExplicitRecordingConsent parameter also controls recording consent for Audio Conferencing. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled

claims.claim: The Audio Conferencing consent page says PowerShell must be used to configure consent.
claims.quote: You must use PowerShell to configure explicit recording and transcription consent for users or groups in your organization.

claims.claim: The consent policy applies to meetings created by organisers assigned that meeting policy.
claims.quote: You can use the Teams admin center or PowerShell to manage whether meetings created by organizers with this assigned policy can require participants to provide explicit consent to be recorded and transcribed.

claims.claim: The consent policy also applies to channel meetings.
claims.quote: This policy also applies to channel meetings.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: The participant consent choice is included in the attendance report.
claims.quote: The consent choice for each participant is included in the attendance report.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can see consent data in Teams meeting audit logs in Purview.
claims.quote: The second is with the Added information about meeting participants filter in the Teams meeting audit logs in Purview.

claims.claim: Organisers and co-organisers do not see consent data when attendance reporting is disabled or participants are excluded from the report.
claims.quote: When the attendance report is disabled or participants aren't in the attendance report, organizers and co-organizers don't see consent data.

claims.claim: Administrators can still see consent data in audit logs when attendance reporting does not show it.
claims.quote: Consent data is in the audit logs regardless of your policy that manages the attendance and engagement report or your users' option for tracking attendance.

claims.claim: Teams clients already have a recording and transcription consent experience.
claims.quote: This update aligns PSTN behavior with the existing consent experience in Teams clients

claims.claim: The participant agreement page lists PSTN endpoints in 1:1 calls as auto-consented.
claims.quote: The following user types are auto consented for recording and transcription without any participant interaction. ... PSTN endpoints in 1:1 calls

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The call recording page documents consent for Teams 1:1 VoIP and PSTN calls under the separate Calling policy.
claims.quote: This parameter manages recording consent for Teams 1:1 VoIP and PSTN calls. Audio conferencing and group calls are managed by Teams Meeting Policy.

claims.claim: A Teams client participant who declines consent has a view-only experience.
claims.quote: If a participant responds 'No' to the question, they have a view-only meeting experience.

claims.claim: View-only participants cannot start recording or transcription in meetings requiring explicit consent.
claims.quote: View-only participants can't start recording or transcription for any meetings that require explicit consent.

claims.claim: If a policy mutes all participants on joining, callers must press *5 to raise a hand before providing consent again.
claims.quote: If you use a policy to mute all participants upon joining a meeting, participants must press *5 to raise hand before providing consent again.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Except for joining meetings anonymously, each organisational user needs a Teams license to use Teams.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is included for a consent option inside licensed Teams, with no feature-specific entitlement claimed.
claims.quote: You manage access to Teams at the user level by assigning or removing a Microsoft Teams product license. Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No license specific to this consent extension is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams explicit recording consent PSTN Audio Conferencing consent license pricing meter Teams Premium. Read participant-agreement-recording-transcription, conferencing-recording-consent, user-access and the Teams add-on license search excerpt; no consent-extension license was stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No meter specific to this consent extension is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams explicit recording consent PSTN Audio Conferencing consent license pricing meter Teams Premium. Read the participant agreement, Audio Conferencing consent and Teams license pages and licensing search results; no consent-extension meter was stated.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited Learn explicit-consent pages do not mention GCC High or DoD.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams explicit recording transcription consent PSTN meetings GCC High DoD policy default. Read participant agreement, Audio Conferencing consent, meeting recording and call recording pages; none names these clouds. Government Channel results concern separate 1:1 call consent.

claims.claim: No authentication or access change is described for the consent extension.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams PSTN explicit recording transcription consent authentication access changes separate PSTN prompt admin switch. Read the roadmap, participant agreement, Audio Conferencing consent and search excerpts; none describes an authentication or access change.

claims.claim: The feature requests a participant's consent rather than making that consent decision autonomously.
claims.quote: Once a participant decides to un-mute, they're prompted to provide consent. To consent to be recorded and transcribed, participants can select controls on their dial pad.

claims.claim: Learn lists Mobile Teams, Teams native Mac and Windows, and Teams Web as supported endpoints.
claims.quote: Explicit consent is supported on the following endpoints: ... Mobile Teams (Android and iOS) ... Teams native Mac ... Teams native Windows ... Teams Web

claims.claim: CarPlay, old native clients and Teams Displays are unsupported and have a view-only experience in meetings requiring explicit consent.
claims.quote: In meetings requiring explicit consent, users joining from unsupported endpoints have the view-only experience. ... CarPlay ... Old version native clients ... Teams Displays

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording controls whether users can record meetings.
claims.quote: To allow or prevent meeting recordings ... go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowCloudRecording $true allows recording for users governed by Global.
claims.quote: To allow everyone in your organization to record, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: The pages read give no separate admin switch for the PSTN prompt as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams PSTN consent separate admin switch ExplicitRecordingConsent Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy parameter Enabled AllowCloudRecording; Teams PSTN explicit recording transcription consent authentication access changes separate PSTN prompt admin switch. Read cited consent pages and cmdlet excerpts.

claims.claim: Administrators can use Global or a custom meeting policy for the consent setting.
claims.quote: To apply changes to all users in your organization who don't have an existing policy assignment, use the Global policy. To exclude certain users from the global policy, create and assign a custom meeting policy.

claims.claim: The consent meeting policy can be assigned to users or groups.
claims.quote: To assign the policy: To specific users: Select your policy > select Manage users > Assign users ... To groups: Select Group policy assignment > select Add > enter the group's name and enter the policy's name > select Apply.

claims.claim: Turning meeting recording Off prevents users governed by that policy from recording meetings.
claims.quote: You can use the Microsoft Teams admin center or PowerShell to control whether your users can record meetings and events. ... To allow or prevent meeting recordings ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: The Meeting recording control permits or prevents recording rather than prompting participants for consent.
claims.quote: To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter ... Manage whether meetings require participant agreement for recording and transcription ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled

claims.claim: The roadmap recommends informing users so they are prepared to provide consent when prompted.
claims.quote: We recommend informing users about this change so they are prepared to provide consent when prompted.

claims.claim: The roadmap description does not mention the consent policy or qualify its rollout prompt statement by the policy being enabled.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams explicit recording transcription consent PSTN meetings GCC High DoD policy default. Read the complete roadmap description and the cited consent pages; the description states prompting after rollout but names no meeting policy or enablement prerequisite.

claims.claim: The meeting policy ExplicitRecordingConsent parameter also manages recording consent for Audio Conferencing.
claims.quote: You can use the Teams admin center or the -ExplicitRecordingConsent parameter in the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet to manage recording consent. This parameter also manages recording consent for Audio Conferencing.
